modules.description: Modules of the `module_map` that got a dev agent. One agent per module, each in an isolated worktree.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or task not found.

409.description: No current module_map, or execution already active.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
